title: 2006 AMC 8 Problem 19
statement: Triangle \(ABC\) is an isosceles triangle with \(\overline{AB}=\overline{BC}.\) Point \(D\) is the midpoint of both \(\overline{BC}\) and \(\overline{AE},\) and \(\overline{CE}\) is \(11\) units long. Triangle \(ABD\) is congruent to triangle \(ECD.\) What is the length of \(\overline{BD}?\)

solutions.text:
By the congruency condition, we know that \[AB = EC = 11.\]

Also from the isosceles condition, we know that \[BC = AB = 11.\]

Since \(D\) is the midpoint of \(\overline{BC},\) we know that \[BD = BC \div 2 = 5.5.\]

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: Use the congruent triangles to relate \(EC\) and \(AB\).
Then use \(AB=BC\) and the fact that \(D\) is the midpoint of \(BC\).
